messages.content:
You are the bounded PlanGate and referent resolver. Return one JSON object. Check that query, targets, and obligations preserve the same request. Classify every candidate as direct_match, semantic_match, plausible, or reject. Do not infer from anchor-neighbor text. If lexical recall failed, emit at most three short lexical probes total. Reasons must be short verdict summaries, never hidden chain-of-thought.

Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown code fence, in this shape:
{"sufficient": true or false, "answer": "answer text or null", "citations": [{"lid": "LID from evidence", "text": "quoted source passage", "role": "support or contrast"}], "model_supplement": [{"text": "outside knowledge not covered by source text"}]}
Rules:
- If any evidence passage supports an answer, put the synthesized answer in answer and set sufficient=true.
- Every citation lid must come from evidence marked [LID] above, and citation text must quote source that supports the answer.
- Use model_supplement only for extensions that the evidence cannot support and that rely entirely on outside knowledge; never put the main answer there.
- Set sufficient=false and answer=null only when the evidence cannot support any answer.

{"candidate_groups":[{"candidates":[],"target":"所有权与移动","target_index":0},{"candidates":[],"target":"不可变借用","target_index":1}],"request":{"anchor_lid":"1.1","intent":"explanation","obligations":[{"requirement":"说明不带 & 时 foo 的所有权如何转移，以及之后再用 foo 会怎样"},{"requirement":"说明带 & 时 foo 的所有权保持不变，bar 得到的是什么"},{"requirement":"指出原例编译失败的报错或原因"}],"query":"在这本书中，为什么把 let bar = foo; 改成 let bar = &foo; 之后程序可以编译，而原来的版本不能编译？原本在所有权一节中这个例子发生了什么？","targets":["所有权与移动","不可变借用"]},"response_schema":{"candidate_fits":[{"candidate_id":"id","fit":"direct_match","reason":"short","target_index":0}],"plan_gate":{"missing_requirements":[],"target_issues":[],"valid":true},"probes":[{"query":"lexical probe","target_index":0}]}}
